summary: Someone else is present at the desk while the official and visitor speak to each other.
realLife: owner, Nov 16: Distinguish a silent person in the room from the person taking the speaking turn.
inGame: needs: identify a present non-speaker in the scene cast before referring to their presence.

turns.what: The listener waits until the visitor leaves before asking the official a question.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor was addressing the official privately about their case.
turns.writesBack: A separate conversation occurs after the visit.
